_comment: Curated open-licence art and audio for The Awakening.
The game is complete and coherent with none of this: every surface and every
sound is generated at runtime (see TextureFactory and ProceduralAudio). These
packs replace the generated versions by name, with no code change, and are what
IMPORTANT — read docs/ASSETS.md before shipping a build. Each pack keeps its own
licence; the fetcher writes an ATTRIBUTION.md next to whatever it downloads.
The 'verified' flag records whether a download URL was confirmed reachable at
the time this manifest was written. Entries marked false use the documented
public API pattern for that source but were not confirmed, because the machine
this file was authored on had no egress to art hosts. The fetcher reports a
clear error rather than failing silently, and every entry carries a sourceUrl
you can open to grab the file by hand.

surfaces.notes: Pale, bedded limestone. Rename the albedo/normal/ARM maps per docs/ASSETS.md.
Darker and wetter. Used below the historic high-water mark.
Sprayed concrete for the adits and the built rooms.
Pipework, catwalks, the grate, the endoskeletons.
The generated version is a deliberately garish 1979 confetti pattern; a real scan is calmer. Keep whichever you prefer.

environment.notes: Optional. The cave is fully enclosed, so this only affects reflection probes. Resolved through the documented api.polyhaven.com/files endpoint.

audio.licence: Royalty-free, commercial use permitted; see the bundle's own licence file
audio.notes: Tens of gigabytes and distributed as yearly torrents, so it is not auto-downloadable. Worth taking the cave tones, water and metal impacts by hand. Drop clips into Assets/Game/Resources/Audio/ named GeneratorHum, FanLoop, PumpLoop, Cavitation, Static, CaveAmbience, Drip, MetalImpact, DoorCycle, BreakerClack, Footstep, Jumpscare, DawnChime to override the synthesised versions.

audio.licence: Varies per clip — check each; prefer CC0
audio.notes: Freesound requires an account and an API key for programmatic download, so this one is a browse link by design.

models.notes: The cast is generated by AnimatronicFactory and needs no downloaded models. If you want sculpted characters instead, replace AnimatronicModelSpawner with a prefab reference and keep the AnimatronicRig bone names — ServoAnimator drives the rig by reference, not by name lookup, so any rig works once wired. Quaternius and Kenney both publish CC0 character and prop packs suitable as a base. Do NOT use Five Nights at Freddy's character models or rips: they are Scott Cawthon's IP and this project ships none of them.
